overview: The committee met to prioritize the 2024-2025 governing agenda and review pending items in committee. Members established timelines for fiscal ordinances, including the annual budget process and a proposed commercial vacancy tax.

items.title: Review of 2024-2025 Governing Agenda
items.summary: The committee reviewed the 2024-2025 governing agenda to establish priorities for upcoming budget cycles and fiscal ordinance updates.

items.title: Discussion of Old Papers in Committee
items.summary: Members discussed the status of several pending papers from prior terms, including proposals for municipal mini-bonds and administrative consolidation between city and school departments.

items.title: Classification and Compensation Study Update
items.summary: The committee requested that the administration provide an update by February 20th regarding the status of the ongoing classification and compensation study.

items.title: Revenue Generation and Proposition 2 1/2 Planning
items.summary: Councilors discussed the formation of a financial task force and the long-term planning required for potential debt exclusions or operating budget overrides.

items.title: Commercial Vacancy and Good Landlord Tax Incentives
items.summary: The committee explored implementation timelines and the regulatory mechanisms for a proposed commercial vacancy tax and a good landlord tax credit.

items.title: PILOT Commission Ordinance Addition
items.summary: Approved adding a draft ordinance for a Payment in Lieu of Taxes (PILOT) commission to the formal governing agenda.
